kitDescription: Folkwang is a pure sustain Defender whose kit contains zero damage effects of any kind. Her first passive (30s cooldown) places a 10-second shield equal to 13.71% of her own Max HP on the two allies with the highest final ATK, and also boosts the healing they receive by 45.7% for 10 seconds. Her second passive (20s cooldown) taunts the highest-ATK enemy for 5 seconds and raises her own Max HP by 44.96% for 10 seconds. Her Burst II gives the same two top-ATK allies a larger shield (32.9% of her Max HP, 10 seconds) and a 10-second heal-over-time that recovers HP based on their attack damage. In game terms she is a shield-and-heal support whose value is keeping the team's two main attackers alive.

verdictRationale: No real gotchas. All six kit lines are FAITHFUL or DOCUMENTED_GAP: both shields carry the correct trigger identity (interval 30s datamined / burstCast own-cast), the literal byFinalAtk top-2 target set, and 10s durations; the S2 Max HP line uses the convertible targetMaxHpPct key with cadence and inertness both behaviorally pinned; the burst lifesteal rider — the gauntlet's one substantive dispute — is now modeled as the ticks:10 HoT that all three blind agents independently demanded and that the owner-landed marciana override precedent (identical prose construction) sanctions, with its magnitude and tick count honestly ⚑-flagged rather than fudged. The S5 reds are 13/13 mechanical or recon errors (nonexistent kind:shield/kind:recovery event APIs, a .blocks schema shape, a vacuous controlComp B2-slot fixture its own sanity test catches, an incomingHealingPct stat that does not exist, a null-vs-undefined nit) — none reflects a real encoding fault, and the HoT the blind test demands is shipped and green through the real consumer observable. The S6 divergences (both passive CDs written 40s vs datamined 30/20; the inert raw maxHpPct key) are blind errors the driver is verifiably correct on. Discrimination is strong: every load-bearing assertion has a proven-red counterfactual (strip, shield-as-heal, wrong CD, raw stat key, fullBurstEnter over-fire via the competing-B2 fixture, ticks:1, dropped rider), and CW1 clean-weapon byte-identity passes 27/27 with per-unit inertness non-vacuous (team totals move through the tandem channels while her own never does). Residual same-model risk for owner spot-check: the interval first-fire phase (t=CD vs t=0) is an engine-wide ⚑ convention no agent here could independently measure, and the ticks:10 count inherits marciana's ⚑ estimate — both are flagged in the override caveats with recipes, which is the sanctioned disposition.
